nature_question: Must an integrated complex organ evolve as an integrated unit?
public_evidence_ceiling: normal heads become upright after flowering
species-wide variation in capitulum size and phyllary-row number reported
same-population independent multi-component segregation not yet demonstrated
hard_stops: post-anthesis upright heads cannot define an upright-flowering morph
species authority states cannot substitute for same-individual phenotype
distant population balancing cannot be called segregation
stickiness cannot rescue the gate post hoc
natural reassembly requires both directly observed combinations and genomic segregation
taxonomically unresolved individuals cannot fill primary combinatorial cells

orientation_geometry.intermediate_rule: 60<angle<120 retained continuously but excluded from binary-cell occupancy

cs0_priority_localities.access: Natural Monument; permitted-path observation only unless separate authorization is obtained.
cs0_priority_localities.rationale: Type locality of C. sieboldii f. leucanthum and current public locality support; verify white/non-white frequency and measure A1-A2 orientation where visible.
Public field record of C. sieboldii at this wetland and high observation feasibility; measure A1-A2 orientation on a spatially spread census and prospectively screen colour.

cs0_priority_localities.access: Boardwalk/designated observation areas; plant collection prohibited; some zones inaccessible.
cs0_priority_localities.rationale: A 2022 local report states that upward-facing flowering Maa-azami predominated, but the site flora also contains Satsuma-maa-azami, so every scored individual requires explicit focal-taxon verification.

public_prescreen_ceiling: Public sources now support local-area and population-level anthesis-orientation variation, but still do not establish same-population colour x orientation co-segregation in verified focal C. sieboldii.

public_flowering_window.operational_note: Early October remains within the documented species/field flowering window, but current-site flowering must be verified before census.

primary_taxonomic_rule.occupancy_rule: Only high-confidence focal C. sieboldii individuals can contribute to primary CS_GREEN or CS_GREEN_LOCAL_SET thresholds.
